description: Backend enhancements: Add new Group fields (Banner, Notice, Rules), new API endpoint for group sticky topics, and update response structures to support the Tieba-style group detail page.
steps: Add new fields to the Group model in internal/models/models.go: Banner (string, cover/banner image URL), Notice (text, group announcement), Rules (text, group rules/guidelines).
Add IsDefault field to GroupResponse in internal/models/resp/response.go, and add the new fields Banner, Notice, Rules to GroupResponse.
Update the BuildGroup function in internal/handlers/render/group_render.go to include the new fields (Banner, Notice, Rules, IsDefault) in the response.

Add a new method to groupService in internal/services/group_service.go: GetGroupStickyTopics(groupId int64) []models.Topic - queries topics where group_id=groupId AND sticky=true AND status=ok, ordered by sticky_time desc.
Add a new API handler GroupStickyTopics in internal/handlers/api/group_handlers.go that takes groupId param and returns sticky topics for that group using render.BuildSimpleTopics.
Register the new route GET /api/group/sticky_topics in internal/server/router.go within the groupGroup.
Add Banner, Notice, Rules fields to the admin dashboard group form fields in web/app/routes/dashboard.groups.tsx (Banner as image type, Notice and Rules as textarea).
Create a database migration file migrations/000023_migration_script_group_tieba_fields.go that uses AutoMigrate to add the new columns to the groups table.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./... passes with no errors
The Group model has Banner, Notice, and Rules fields with proper GORM tags
GroupResponse includes banner, notice, rules, and isDefault fields in JSON
New /api/group/sticky_topics endpoint is registered and handler implemented
Migration file exists and follows the project migration pattern
Dashboard form includes the new fields
verification: Run 'go build ./...' from project root to confirm compilation
Run 'go test ./...' from project root to confirm tests pass
Run 'pnpm typecheck' in web/ to confirm frontend still compiles after dashboard changes
findings: Pre-existing test failures in internal/server (SPA embed tests) and TypeScript errors in groups.$slug.tsx / groups._index.tsx are unrelated to this feature. Go build succeeds. The web/build/spa/ directory needs to exist with at least one file for go build to work (placeholder.html used).
